scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.assets:validate: node scripts/assets/validate-manifests.mjs && node scripts/assets/check-filenames.mjs && node scripts/assets/check-missing-files.mjs && node scripts/assets/check-dimensions.mjs
